speaker: gauge
text: Big orange balls on the power lines? Decorations. I'll take them down.

speaker: fitz
text:
Wait. Those are markers for pilots.
From a plane or helicopter, thin wires blend into the background, especially when flying low. Big bright balls show where the wires are.

speaker: fitz
text:
Mostly near airports. And where lines span rivers, lakes or canyons, the FAA wants them at least three feet across.
The colors alternate, orange, white, yellow, to stand out against any background.

speaker: gauge
text: Ooh, what else is built weird? Subscribe and let's find out.
